# Correctness v1.1: Split and Prototype

## Prototype fix
- ``_formula_to_prototype`` now returns reduced anonymous stoichiometry (e.g. Na2Cl2 and NaCl both → AB).
- New fields: ``chemical_system``, ``reduced_formula``, ``anonymous_formula``, ``structure_prototype``, ``matcher_component``.

## Split leakage
- Train/test must have zero intersection on material ID, reduced formula, and prototype component.
- Leakage tests are required to pass before any model benchmark is reported.
